article.title: 阅读 Part B · 和陌生人自然聊起来的五种方法
article.context: 把对话比作不断加强的“连接”，以直接、轻松的口吻给出与陌生人开启并维持交流的五种做法：先开口、跳过客套、寻找共同点、全心在场、记住细节。
rows: Conversations are links, which means when you have a conversation with a new person a link gets formed and every conversation you have after that moment will strengthen the link.
对话就是连接：当你与一个陌生人交谈时，一条连接便由此形成；此后的每一次交谈，都会让这条连接更加牢固。
advance
You meet new people every day: the grocery worker, the cab driver, new people at work or the security guard at the door.
你每天都会遇到新的人：杂货店员工、出租车司机、工作中的新同事，或门口的保安。
example
Simply starting a conversation with them will form a link.
只要主动和他们说上几句话，就会建立起一条连接。
conclude
Here are five simple ways that you can make the first move and start a conversation with strangers.
下面有五种简单的方法，能帮助你迈出第一步，与陌生人展开交谈。
advance
Suppose you are in a room with someone you don't know and something within you says "I want to talk with this person" - this is something that mostly happens with all of us.
假设你和一个不认识的人同处一室，心里有个声音说：“我想和这个人聊聊。”——这种情况我们大多数人都经历过。
example
You wanted to say something - the first word - but it just won't come out, it feels like it is stuck somewhere.
你想说点什么，想说出第一句话，可话就是出不了口，仿佛卡在了某个地方。
explain
I know the feeling and here is my advice: just get it out.
我懂这种感觉，而我的建议很简单：把第一句话说出来。
encourage
Just think: what is the worst that could happen?
想一想：最糟又能怎样？
ask
They won't talk with you?
他们不理你？
ask
Well, they are not talking with you now!
可他们现在本来就没在和你说话呀！
playful
I truly believe that once you get that first word out everything else will just flow.
我真心相信，只要第一句话说出口，后面的交流自然就会顺起来。
encourage
So keep it simple: "Hi", "Hey" or "Hello" - do the best you can to gather all of the enthusiasm and energy you can, put on a big smile and say "Hi".
所以别想得太复杂：“Hi”“Hey”或“Hello”都行——尽量调动起自己的热情和活力，露出一个大大的笑容，说声“Hi”。
encourage
It is a problem all of us face; you have limited time with the person that you want to talk with and you want to make this talk memorable.
这是我们都会遇到的问题：你和想交谈的人相处时间有限，却又希望这次谈话能给对方留下印象。
advance
Honestly, if we got stuck in the rut of "hi", "hello", "how are you?" and "what is going on?", you will fail to give the initial jolt to the conversation that can make it so memorable.
说实话，如果总困在“嗨”“你好”“最近怎么样”“发生什么了”这些老套寒暄里，你就很难给谈话一个足以让人记住的开场冲击。
contrast
So don't be afraid to ask more personal questions.
所以，不要害怕问一些更私人、更深入的问题。
encourage
Trust me, you'll be surprised to see how much people are willing to share if you just ask.
相信我，只要你开口问，你会惊讶地发现人们其实愿意分享很多。
encourage
When you meet a person for the first time, make an effort to find the things which you and that person have in common so that you can build the conversation from that point.
第一次见到一个人时，尽量找出你们之间的共同点，再从那里把谈话展开。
encourage
When you start conversation from there and then move outwards, you'll find all of a sudden that the conversation becomes a lot easier.
从共同点开始，再一点点向外延伸，你会突然发现，聊天变得容易多了。
conclude
Imagine you are pouring your heart out to someone and they are just busy on their phone, and if you ask for their attention you get the response "I can multitask".
想象一下，你正在向一个人敞开心扉，对方却只顾低头玩手机；你请他专心一点，他还回你一句：“我可以一心多用。”
example
So when someone tries to communicate with you, just be in that communication wholeheartedly.
所以，当有人想和你交流时，就全心全意地投入这场交流。
encourage
Make eye contact.
看着对方的眼睛。
encourage
Trust me, eye contact is where all the magic happens.
相信我，眼神交流正是奇妙之处发生的地方。
encourage
When you make eye contact, you can feel the conversation.
当你与对方目光相接时，你才能真正感受到这场对话。
conclude
You all came into a conversation where you first met the person, but after some time you may have met again and have forgotten their name.
我们都有过这种经历：第一次和某人聊过天，过了一阵再见面，却已经忘了对方的名字。
example
Isn't that awkward!
这不是很尴尬吗！
playful

So, remember the little details of the people you met or you talked with; perhaps the places they have been to, the places they want to go, the things they like, the things they hate - whatever you talk about.
所以，要记住你见过、聊过的人的一些小细节：他们去过哪里、想去哪里、喜欢什么、讨厌什么——凡是你们谈到过的，都可以记下来。
encourage
When you remember such things you can automatically become investor in their wellbeing.
当你记得这些细节时，你自然而然就会成为一个真正关心他们生活的人。
explain
So they feel a responsibility to you to keep that relationship going.
于是，对方也会觉得有责任把这段关系继续维持下去。
conclude
That's it.
就是这些。
conclude
Five amazing ways that you can make conversation with almost anyone.
五种很有效的方法，让你几乎可以和任何人聊起来。
conclude
Every person is a really good book to read, or to have a conversation with!
每个人都像一本值得读的好书，也都值得你去与之交谈！
conclude
